---
description: Five-axis review before merge
---

Use the code-review-and-quality skill (`.github/skills/code-review-and-quality/SKILL.md`; security-and-hardening / performance-optimization on those axes).
Review staged/recent changes across correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance. Categorize Critical/Important/Suggestion with file:line refs. Verify the ClearDue approval gate, credits, and secrets hygiene.
